summary: Iteration 7 (SHARE + SUBSCRIBE + FOLLOW buttons under live player) fully verified. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass covering subscribe/unsubscribe endpoints, auth requirement, self-subscribe 400, non-existent channel 404, idempotency, GET /channels/{u} with/without auth (subscriber_count + is_subscribed), GET /channels/mine subscriber_count, and Mongo unique compound index on (subscriber_uid, channel_username). Frontend: All acceptance criteria verified via Playwright against the preview URL — three data-testids render on /channel/testdj, SHARE copies URL and shows COPIED state + toast 'Channel link copied.', SUBSCRIBE toggles SUBSCRIBE·0 ↔ SUBSCRIBED·1, logged-out user sees subscribe-login-cta instead, own-channel hides both follow-btn and subscribe-btn while keeping share-btn. FOLLOW regression works (FOLLOWING·10 ↔ FOLLOW·9).

backend.test_subscribe_and_unsubscribe_flow: PASS — count +1, idempotent, is_subscribed toggles, follower_count regression intact, anonymous excludes is_subscribed/is_following
backend.test_unique_index_prevents_duplicates: PASS — unique compound index verified in db.subscriptions.index_information()

frontend.share_button_click: PASS — text becomes 'COPIED', clipboard contains https://.../channel/testdj, toast 'Channel link copied.' visible
frontend.own_channel_hides_follow_and_subscribe: PASS — share=1, follow=0, subscribe=0, sub_cta=0 as testdj@pirate.radio on /channel/testdj

critical_code_review_comments: SubscribeButton.jsx: bare `catch {}` swallows API error details — no distinction between 401/network/500 for the toast; acceptable for MVP.
ShareButton.jsx: navigator.share AbortError is handled, but other errors silently fall through to clipboard which is the correct UX. OK.

server.py: subscribe endpoint catches all Exception broadly (line ~608) to swallow duplicate-key from unique index; consider narrowing to DuplicateKeyError to avoid masking unrelated failures. Non-blocking.
channel_public() signature is getting long (6 optional kwargs); consider consolidating counters/flags into a nested 'stats' dict in future iterations.
seed_data_creation: Test creates transient sub_<hex>@sparkz.tv users via /auth/register in pytest scope; sidebar user was used for UI subscribe/unsubscribe (state left clean — final action was unsubscribe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Subscribe feature works end-to-end. Reusable pytest module: /app/backend/tests/test_subscribe.py. Frontend selectors confirmed: share-btn, follow-btn, subscribe-btn, subscribe-login-cta. Note: SHARE test relied on granting clipboard permissions via context.grant_permissions before navigation; do the same when re-verifying. Follower count for testdj at end of run: 9. Subscriber count for testdj: 0 (cleaned up).
